name: oby-check
description: Oby's check (scripts/oby-check.sh) as BLOK nodes, in shadow mode. The script plans which groups a change reaches; each step runs one group's suites in a node of this tool's Rust runtime, and the verdicts fold into one: failed, else couldn't judge, else passed. Only the script decides publishing and merging.

steps.description: obid's affected Rust suites: fmt, clippy, the touched lib modules and test binaries.
The Apple apps' touched suites and swift test. In a job's box the script skips them, as it says, and passes.
The Electron app's typecheck, build and vitest.
gitleaks on what changed. Nothing goes out unless it's clean.
